A split conceptual illustration. On the left side, a harsh, overly bright sun (representing "gaudy day"). On the right side, a serene, cloudless night sky filled with bright stars (representing the balance of "dark and bright"). In the centre, the elegant silhouette of a woman in a long dark gown in early 19th-century style, with a soft glow around her face.

A cartoon-style illustration showing the climax of the tale. A reddish-orange fox stands at the base of a large tree, looking up with a sly, frustrated expression. High up on a branch sits a magnificent golden rooster (Chauntecleer), looking down triumphantly. In the background, a small cottage and a widow with a distaff (spinning stick) and her daughters running after them.
